protocol: One fresh production Metal server and one 8-input/8-output warmup per measured request. No experimental policy overrides, no draft attached. BF16 KV, one slot, context and batch 4096, microbatch 8. ATOMIC_WINDOW_PROFILE logs the path selected. Uncached greedy completion, 64 output tokens, ignore EOS, seed 42. TTFT runs from client POST until the first SSE event with a sampled token ID; TPS is 63 divided by seconds between first and last token events. Startup and warmup excluded. Sequential measurements; OS file cache uncontrolled. One observation per cell. Budget is the managed engine cap.

inputs.archive: Previously benchmarked 4000-token Flash Next fixture from the Metal wide matrix.
inputs.handover: Same user text as the Qwen3.6 low-budget multiprompt handover fixture. Native Flash Next chat template with thinking disabled, parse_special=true, add_special=false. All 912 IDs match the earlier Qwen3.6 input.
inputs.aligned: Same 912 token IDs, with 112 one-space token IDs inserted immediately before the first user word. Sent as token IDs so the padding is not merged by a tokenizer. Diagnostic input at 12 GiB.
